_readme: Badge DEFINITIONS (what a badge is). Ownership (who has which badge) lives in the user_badges table.
This file is read once at server start and is never writable through the API — edit it, review it, deploy it.
To add a badge: add an entry below and restart. No frontend change is needed.
name / description   Shown in the tooltip and admin UI.
icon                 SVG shapes on a 24x24 grid, stroke-based (stroke=currentColor is applied by CSS). Only
path/circle/rect/line/polyline/polygon/ellipse with plain attributes are accepted; anything
else is rejected at load. fill/stroke may only be 'none' or 'currentColor'.
color                Fixed hex, identical for every viewer (deliberately NOT tied to the viewer's --accent).
tier                 'staff' (filled chip) | 'special' (tinted gradient + soft glow) | 'common' (tinted chip).
order                Lower numbers render first. Controls badge ordering everywhere.
hidden               true = internal badge: only administrators ever see it (profiles, lists, admin UI).
assignable           false = cannot be granted/revoked via the admin UI or API.
derivedFromRole      Badge is computed from users.role (e.g. 'ADMIN') instead of stored ownership. Because it
mirrors real privileges it can never be granted to someone who isn't actually that role.
